messages:
Maya (support): FYI Acme reported a weird quota hit during our rolling cutover of quota-service v2. UI showed 0 credits for their tenant (acme-123) and API returned 429 for ~12m, then the UI showed a partial/staggered refill in waves. They didn't change usage. Repro steps they provided below; pasted logs attached. Can infra/oncall advise? @Jin @Ava

Jin (oncall): Thanks Maya. Do we have deploy timestamps? Want to check if the cutover overlapped with cache invalidation TTLs. Also need exact API responses and X-Quota headers if present.

deploy-bot: deployment quota-service:v2 started rollout at 2024-11-18T03:45:00Z (ts=1719999900) across us-west/us-east-eu zones. Canary passed, autoswap enabled.

Ava (infra): Copy. Two quick hypotheses: 1) rolling nodes brought up with cold caches while edge cache still serving old tokens -> double-write/read race producing transient 0; 2) refill/ledger writes got behind due to a short spike while DB shards were rebalanced. Looking at logs now.

Maya (support): Repro steps customer sent: 
```
1) Start 50 parallel embed requests against /v1/embeddings for tenant acme-123
2) Observe ~10-20 concurrent retries -> API returns 429s
3) UI shows credits = 0 for ~12 minutes, then shows +20% then +60% then full over ~20 minutes
```
They also pasted a snippet: 
```
WARN 2024-11-18T03:46:12Z cache.miss tenant=acme-123 key=quota:acme-123
ERROR 2024-11-18T03:46:13Z quota.check deny tenant=acme-123 remaining=-120 requested=1024
INFO  2024-11-18T03:46:50Z refill.scheduled tenant=acme-123 amount=500 reason=topup
```
Jin (oncall): The remaining=-120 log is the killer. That suggests a double-draw or ledger write was applied twice or an inconsistent read returned stale 0 then ledger replay bumped it in waves. Was there any split-brain on our write path during canary?

Ava (infra): We did flip the routing flag to route some shard writes to new writer pool during canary. I see a narrow window where read path used old edge cache (TTL 300s) while writes hit new writer which didn't seed the edge until background writer warmed up. Edge continued to serve cached zero for tenants that hit miss->negative calculation path. I can repro locally by bringing down the seeding job and sending burst traffic.

Carlos (billing): To confirm: this is not the monthly reset. It's mid-cycle for Acme (their monthly bucket should be ~60% full). We haven't auto-compensated because billing wont do retro credits unless it's a system-wide bug. If we confirm rollout-induced inconsistency we can arrange a one-off credit to make Acme whole.

Ava (infra): Immediate mitigation I pushed: purge edge cache for acme-123 and enabled warm-seed during rollout. Command used: 
```
curl -X POST "https://infra-admin.internal/edge/purge" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"acme-123"}'
```
Followed by: 
```
curl -X POST "https://infra-admin.internal/quota/force-seed" -d '{"tenant":"acme-123","amount":600}'
```
This restored visible tokens within ~45s for them.

Maya (support): Customer confirmed partial recovery after we ran purge+seed. They want RCA and compensation. Also asked for repro steps for their SREs.

Jin (oncall): Next actions Im logging: 
- root cause: edge-cache TTL + writer warm-seed gap during rolling rollout -> transient negative reads and negative allowed remaining calc path.
- short-term: a) ensure purge+seed is a documented runbook; b) CLI tool to target tenants impacted by rollout; c) billing follow-up for manual credit (Carlos).
- long-term: change rollout to pre-seed writer -> edge switch, or disable negative remaining calc (fail-safe to floor at 0 and queue writes).

Ava (infra): Filed infra issue INFRA-4982: "Ensure quota writer warm-seed before route flip; add pre-rollout seeding + healthcheck". PR incoming to add a gating step to deployment pipeline and reduce edge TTL to 60s during rollouts.

Carlos (billing): I'll prepare a note for account team and propose a one-time 10% credit to Acme pending a final RCA. If the RCA shows we caused it, billing will approve.

Maya (support): Workaround/bugnote added to the ticket we have with Acme. I also asked them to capture X-Quota-Remaining/X-Quota-Version headers next time and to avoid sending burst >50 concurrent while we ship the gating. They appreciated the quick purge.

Jin (oncall): Follow-ups assigned: INFRA-4982 (Ava), QUOTA-394 (disable negative-remaining fast-fail) (me), Support runbook RB-77 (Maya). ETA for hotfix: 48h to get gating + pre-seed in place.

Ava (infra): Confirmed well also add an automated check post-rollout to scan for tenants with sudden drop to <=5% and auto-trigger seed/purge within first 10m.

Maya (support): Closing loop with Acme: sent summary and ETA. Will keep thread updated if they see any recurrence. :white_check_mark:

Jin (oncall): Thanks all. If anyone sees additional tenants with similar pattern in the next 24h please ping #incidents and add tenant id.
